name: operations
title: Operations
description: An incident log, a change log, a contacts/escalation list, and a health-check section in the runbook.
audience: Operational and concrete: lead with current state and impact, then what changed, what to watch and who to call; give exact commands and a rollback.

files.content:
# {TITLE} incident log

<!-- One entry per incident, newest first: when, impact, cause, fix, follow-up. -->

| Date | Impact | Cause | Fix | Follow-up |
|---|---|---|---|---|

# {TITLE} change log

<!-- Every change to production: when, what, who, window, rollback. -->

| Date | Change | By | Window | Rollback |
|---|---|---|---|---|

# {TITLE} contacts and escalation

<!-- Who to call, in what order, for what. -->

| Role | Name | How to reach | When |
|---|---|---|---|

sections.heading: Health check and common fixes
sections.body: <!-- How to check this system is healthy, and the fixes that work. One procedure per sub-heading. -->

pane.label: Start my day
pane.prompt: Start my day: show what is waiting for me, what is overdue and what I should do first.

pane.label: Add a task
pane.prompt: I want to add a task. Ask me what it is and which project it belongs to.

pane.label: Log an incident
pane.prompt: Add an entry to the incident log. Ask me what happened.

pane.label: Log a change
pane.prompt: Add an entry to the change log. Ask me what changed.

pane.label: Who to call
pane.prompt: Show the contacts and escalation list.

pane.label: Health check
pane.prompt: Run through the health-check section of the runbook with me.

pane.label: Runbook check
pane.prompt: Check my runbooks for content that is repeated and should be shared.

pane.label: Open a project
pane.prompt: Open a project for me. Ask me which one.

pane.label: Find in my notes
pane.prompt: Look something up in my notes. Ask me what I am looking for.

pane.label: Write a handoff
pane.prompt: Write a handoff for the next session so nothing is lost.

pane.label: Sort my inbox
pane.prompt: Review my inbox and file each item into the right project.
